entries.old: Ayurveda, as we already know is one of the oldest medicinal disciplines to exist in the contemporary world. Over the years that it has existed among us, it has been constantly upgraded through research and novel discoveries such that it now stands at its prime position. However, more than the constant evolution of Ayurveda, the thing that makes it so effective and accurate at plucking out maladies is the fact that it doesn’t depend upon synthetic products to fight ailments but rather, all of its potency is the result of natural herbs and medicinal shrubs. Due to the thorough natural ingredients of its medicines, Ayurveda has no side effect which makes it very safe for human bodies.
entries.new: Ayurveda is one of the oldest systems of medicine still practised today, and it continues to be studied and developed. Its medicines are prepared mainly from herbs and other natural ingredients. Natural does not automatically mean free of side effects, so every medicine and therapy at Kairali is prescribed and monitored by our physicians, who take your existing medicines and health conditions into account.

entries.old: However, having negligible side effects is not the only reason why anyone should pick Ayurveda. One of the principal reasons favouring the use Ayurveda is its total potency against afflictions. Where many modern medicines have failed, Ayurveda has proved that it can completely eradicate them, or in the case of complex incurable diseases, control their growth rate. Ayurveda has shown this incredible resistance against diseases such as Diabetes where it has put a regulatory check on the amount of sugar in the blood, thus effectively counteracting it.
entries.new: People also choose Ayurveda for its personalised approach to long-term conditions. For conditions such as diabetes, Ayurvedic care focuses on diet, daily routine, physical activity and therapies alongside the treatment prescribed by your regular doctor; it is not a replacement for prescribed medicines, and any change to them should be made only on your doctor’s advice.

entries.old: With over 115 years of expertise, we’ve aided 30,000+ patients with Ayurvedic principles to treat bronchial conditions. Ayurveda, rooted in holistic healing, recognizes bronchial ailments as respiratory system imbalances from impaired digestion, toxin buildup, and weakened immunity. Our approach identifies the root cause and combines Ayurvedic therapies and herbal medications. Treatment involves personalized dietary advice, breathing exercises, herbal steam inhalation, and specialized massages for respiratory passage opening and detoxification. Ayurvedic remedies, comprising natural herbs, enhance lung function, reduce inflammation, and boost immunity. Our holistic method addresses underlying imbalances, strengthening the respiratory system, and enhancing overall well-being. Beyond symptom relief, Ayurveda promotes a healthy lifestyle and body-mind harmony to prevent future occurrences. Rely on our extensive experience and successful outcomes. We provide personalized care, considering your unique constitution and needs, ensuring lasting relief and optimal respiratory health.
entries.new: Ayurveda understands bronchial complaints as imbalances of the respiratory system, linked in its tradition to digestion, the build-up of toxins and immunity. At Kairali, your programme begins with a physician’s assessment and combines Ayurvedic therapies and herbal medicines with personalised dietary advice, breathing exercises, herbal steam inhalation and massages that support easier breathing. Care also covers daily routine and lifestyle, and it is planned around your individual constitution and the treatment you already receive from your own doctor; it does not replace inhalers or other prescribed medicines.
